reviewer: Codex primary agent inspected all nine recorded-origin contact sheets (202 pairs), then re-inspected pages 5/6 after the radical viewport fix; independent layout agent inspected worst pairs and theme/outline bounds. policy: This frozen list records explicitly reviewed rendering differences allowed by the confirmed minor-antialiasing tolerance. It never changes automatic edge pass/fail. referenceMeasurement: Natural strut bounds and glyph baselines; actual radical path getScreenCTM under CSS viewport. All 202 semantic/geometry/output checks passed.
